description: Dataset of individual Snapchat snaps from curated highlights and active stories, with direct media URLs and creator metadata.

audioTranscriptionObjectUrl.description: URL to audio transcription object (when available)

canonicalUrlSuffix.description: Canonical URL suffix for the story (activeStory only, when present)

emoji.description: Emoji associated with the story (activeStory only, when present)

error.description: Error message if scraping failed for this username

hasAttachment.description: Whether this snap has an attachment

isAttributed.description: Whether the story is attributed to a creator (activeStory only, when present)

isSponsored.description: Whether this snap is sponsored content (when set)

mediaUrl.description: Direct media CDN URL for this snap

postedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this snap was posted

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was scraped

snapId.description: Snap ID (when available; often empty for curated highlights)

snapIndex.description: Zero-based snap position within the highlight

snapSubtitles.description: Subtitle/caption data embedded in the snap (when present)

storyShareId.description: Story share ID (activeStory only, when present)

storySource.description: Source of the story: curatedHighlight or activeStory

storyTapId.description: Story tap-to-reply ID (activeStory only, when present)

subscriberCount.description: Subscriber count (public profiles only, when available)

videoTrackUrl.description: Video track URL (activeStory only, when present)

results.description: Dataset containing scraped story snap records

title: Snapchat Highlight & Story Media Downloader Output
